name: Museum 8
storyline:
Observe the museum. Spot what changed. Choose the right door.

Watch the official gameplay trailer for MUSEUM8 and get a closer look at its core anomaly-hunting gameplay—from subtle changes in the exhibits to encounters that become increasingly difficult to ignore.

Use your camcorder to reveal additional details and unsettling changes within certain anomalies.
